font.reason: The card is a restrained product interface. Variable Vazirmatn supplies the source's regular-to-semibold hierarchy, reliable Persian glyph coverage and natural joining at the pill and caption sizes. FaRoot loads it before rendering.

components.name: DocParkLeftPillDeal

rtlDecisions.what: Parked document position and park motion
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored to the right side; changed the anchor to the right edge and the park translation to +55%.
rtlDecisions.why: The source document sits on the left and slides left as reading-direction layout. Persian reading begins at the right, so its retained source panel belongs there and must travel outward to the right.

rtlDecisions.what: Skeleton document columns and header placeholders
rtlDecisions.action: Mirrored the three column slots and anchored the top placeholders at the right.
rtlDecisions.why: They represent document reading layout; reversing them keeps the first column and header aligned with the Persian reading edge. Skeleton widths and seeded values remain the same.

rtlDecisions.action: Moved the stack from the right to the left side and set each pill row to RTL, placing the icon at the right of its label.
rtlDecisions.why: The cards follow the source's left-to-right reading progression, which becomes right-to-left. Their top-to-bottom order remains because vertical order has no RTL meaning.

rtlDecisions.what: Caption text and progressive word emphasis
rtlDecisions.action: Translated the three captions into concise idiomatic Persian; split on word spaces in logical Persian order, laid out RTL, and removed tracking. Kept the original per-word emphasis and fade timing.
rtlDecisions.why: Persian joins within each word and reads from right to left. Short copy fits the mirrored caption slot below the pills without colliding with the parked document.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept y positions, vertical stack order, opacity, outBack translateY/scale, deal starts, scroll amount and timing curves unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: These are timing/physics and vertical composition semantics rather than reading-direction movement.

rtlDecisions.action: Kept its upward direction, 3-cycle modulo and 40px travel unchanged.
rtlDecisions.why: The slow scroll communicates a document being read while vertical movement remains physical and universal.

rtlDecisions.action: Placed a 172px RTL caption box beneath each pill at the horizontally mirrored location.
rtlDecisions.why: The original caption sits just below and aligns to the inward edge of each pill; mirroring that anchor preserves relationship and clears the parked panel.

components.motionFidelity: Retained 174 frames, T0=[0.26,0.48,0.70], subtitle start/end scheduling, E.outQuad opacity/fade, E.outBack spring, document park interval and easing, seeded skeleton widths, and 3-cycle scrolling. No timing, seed, fps or size changes.

visualVerification.result: Viewed matching Persian and original frames for the sole component, including park progress, all three pill arrivals/caption states, final resting composition and fade state. The Persian font rendered correctly; labels and captions fit; mirrored source/pill balance is clear; no unintended Latin or Chinese on-screen text remains.

rasterHandling.assets: None. The document skeleton and icons are live CSS/SVG shapes.
rasterHandling.action: No raster edits or replacement required; the vector skeleton was mirrored with its document layout.
